boundaries.sdk: ESP-IDF and linked/prebuilt consumers use capability/default heap wrappers. ISR, cache-disabled, DMA and stronger alignment keep the SDK path. Raw pointers never move.
boundaries.interpreters: Lua uses tagged policy. MicroPython owns a fixed GC heap; object collection stays inside the VM.
boundaries.native: Host memory/libc tables use shared policy. Guest pointer graphs stay pinned; handles and suspended cache hooks opt in explicitly.
boundaries.vendor: src/vendor and modules/*/main/vendor retain upstream contracts; linked SDK adapters or guest port shims handle their allocations.
